psychographics.tech_comfort: Moderate — want AI benefits without complexity

pain_points: AI feels too complex and expensive
Data privacy concerns with big AI platforms
aspirations: Get actionable insights from their data
Compete with larger companies using AI

tone_of_voice.voice_characteristics: A knowledgeable friend who explains complex things simply. Never condescending. Always empowering.

tone_variations.formal: For whitepapers and case studies — data-driven, authoritative, but still accessible
tone_variations.casual: For social media and blog posts — conversational, warm, uses 'you' and 'we'
tone_variations.urgent: For limited-time offers — direct, benefit-focused, creates FOMO
tone_variations.empathetic: For support and onboarding — reassuring, patient, celebrates small wins

do_say: AI that works for you, not the other way around
We handle the complexity so you don't have to
Your data. Your control. Your insights.
dont_say: You'll need a data science team

visual_identity.logo_usage: Logo should always have clear space equal to the height of the 'N'. Never stretch or distort. Use white logo on dark backgrounds, full-color on white.
visual_identity.imagery_style: Clean, minimalist product shots with real people using technology. Warm lighting, diverse representation. Avoid generic stock photos of people staring at screens.
